body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose a 3-unit line within weapon range. Compare this Action against each enemy in the line. On a success, deal 1 weapon damage; your Locked target also burns 1 die.

surges.html: Choose one creature this Action succeeds against. Gain +1 die on your next Ballistics Action against it this turn.
Ignore 1 Defense granted by equipment or cover for this Action.

rider.title: SUPPRESSION
rider.html: If your Locked target is affected, it cannot make Reactions against Ballistics Actions until the start of its next turn.
